ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing screening of every director, shareholder, secretary, and beneficial owner against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List (UNSC 1267/1988), UN Security Council ISIL/Al-Qaida lists, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Consolidated List, Interpol Red Notices, and domestic Vanuatu watchlists. Under the AML/CFT Act 2017 §10, licensed agents must refuse or terminate any relationship connected to terrorism, sanctions evasion, or arms embargoes. PEPs (including foreign PEPs, family members, and close associates) require enhanced due diligence, documented source of wealth, and senior-management approval pursuant to AML/CFT Act §11. For ISIC 3040 (military fighting vehicle manufacturing), additional end-user and end-use certification screening is required because the product is on controlled defense trade lists; re-screening of all parties is required at each change of ownership exceeding 25%, every 36 months, and immediately before any transfer or payment commitment.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry — corporate name clearance and reservation conducted through the VFSC e-Registry interface (via licensed Registered Agents only); public name availability search available at www.vfsc.vu (Registry Search)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be expressed in Roman (Latin) alphabetic characters; the Executive Name Committee accepts English, French, or Bislama vocabulary with mandatory transliteration of non-Latin script names into English/French phonetic form. Arabic-script blocs and Chinese characters in the proposed trading name must be romanized and verified as identical or non-conflicting at the VFSC. The name may not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, a reserved name, or a name of a foreign company where material confusion would arise.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a VFSC name-rejection notice, the applicant's Licensed Registered Agent must file a written re-submission and justification with the VFSC Registry within 10 business days of the rejection; the Registry will issue a determination within a further 10 business days. Where rejection is maintained, the applicant may appeal to the responsible Minister (Ministry of Finance and Economic Management) within 14 days by way of a formal petition supported by a legal opinion on compliance with the International Companies Act §3 and the Business Licence Act. The final administrative decision is subject to judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Civil Procedure Rules 2002 Part 33; the court has discretionary power to order the Registrar to register the name. Additionally, for defense-generated tokens (e.g., 'Military', 'Tactical'), the applicant must produce the proposed end-user purchase order or foreign government procurement authorization, and the VFSC will consult with the Customs Division on import/export arms control policy before determining the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office at a licensed agent's physical address in Port Vila satisfies the statutory requirement of the International Companies Act §§ 22–23. A pure virtual (non-physical) office is permissible for statutory presence, but the defense banking and foreign procurement market will treat it as weak substance; the underlying manufacturing phase will necessarily occur outside Vanuatu (e.g., contractual toll manufacturing in a supplier country) because the International Company is prohibited from carrying on domestic business in Vanuatu except with a special license. For the high-risk defense/tactical-vehicle scope, a physical Vanuatu office (agent's floor or rented suite) is strongly recommended to support bank account opening, and a board resolution must record the substance rationale and outbound sourcing chain.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 30% probability of a VFSC or Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) risk-based inspection or adjusted CDD enquiry within the first 12 months for a High_Risk_Special_License entity; 15% probability of an unannounced physical site visit to the registered address to verify that the registered agent and office actually host records; 45% likelihood of a substance-and-end-use due diligence questionnaire or a formal request for source-of-funds documentation from the correspondent bank and RBV before any government wire or diplomatic letter of credit is processed. Military manufacturing classification materially elevates the likelihood of enhanced supervision compared with a standard trading International Company.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Vanuatu), as amended; ss. 4, 6, 8, 13, 16 and 24; subordinate regulations under VFSC directives
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VU-IC Form 1), together with Memorandum and Articles of Association and Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Vanuatu International Company; no escrow or paid-up capital deposit is required; shares may be issued at par value stated in the Memorandum, and consideration need not be paid immediately unless Articles require otherwise
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers named herein subscribe to one ordinary share each and that the authorized share capital set out in the Memorandum and Articles of Association is adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the company be fixed at Port Vila, Vanuatu, as designated by the registered agent, and that the registered agent shall maintain custody of statutory registers. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed as director and [Name] as company secretary, each consenting to act, with authority to administer the affairs of the company. RESOLVED FURTHER that the director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute commercial contracts, engage counsel, and obtain all necessary business, industrial, and environmental licenses. RESOLVED FINALLY that these resolutions take effect immediately and that the minutes be recorded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed International Company name through the VFSC online portal, specifying the activity as manufacture of armored security personnel transport vehicles. Verify that the name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name and does not imply a prohibited connection with the Government of Vanuatu. Once cleared, pay the applicable search and reservation fee via the VFSC payment gateway and obtain the name reservation confirmation notice.
required_dossiers: Completed Name Reservation Application
Certified copy of passport for each subscriber and director
Proof of registered agent appointment (VFSC licensed agent)
Short description of intended business scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected or queried, submit an alternative name list of up to three names, or file written explanations to the VFSC Registry within 5 business days to demonstrate non-conflict and compliance with Part 3 of the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC licensed registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, reflecting the authorized share capital, registered office in Vanuatu, permitted objects including defense-sector manufacturing, and limitations on activities inconsistent with International Company status. Arrange notarization and legalization of subscriber signatures and, where required, apostille or consular legalization for foreign corporate shareholders.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber consent forms and share subscription agreements
Registered agent consent letter
Notarized passport copies or certificate of incorporation for corporate subscribers
Power of attorney for each subscriber, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC Registrar returns the documents for correction, amend the defective clauses within 7 business days via the registered agent and resubmit through the same filing channel; no additional statutory fee applies for a first correction unless a new name or change of director is involved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registration Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Form 1 application along with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, certified copies of the name reservation, registered agent consent, and director consents, either electronically through the VFSC portal or physically at the VFSC offices in Port Vila. Pay the US$250 government registration fee and any agent service fees. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation once all statutory conditions are satisfied.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form 1 Application for Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association (signed and notarized)
Name reservation confirmation
Registered agent consent and registered office address in Vanuatu
Director and secretary consents
Receipt of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or defective, the VFSC Registry will issue a notice of deficiency with a 14-day cure period; correct the deficiencies and resubmit. If the application is refused, appeal to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Tribunal or apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review as provided under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office in Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, either physically or virtually, in accordance with the Articles. The board adopts the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, director and officer appointments, and authorization to pursue licensing. The secretary records the minutes, registers share allotments, and opens statutory registers for directors, members, charges, and meetings.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Minutes of first board meeting
Register of members, directors, and secretaries
Share certificates issued to subscribers
Registered agent statement of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a board quorum or voting irregularity is identified, reconvene the meeting with proper notice and obtain written unanimous resolutions or unanimous consent minutes to cure the procedural defect; file the corrected minutes with the registered agent and VFSC if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License, Industrial Licensing, and Operational Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry / Municipality of Port Vila and Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, apply for the Business License from the Vanuatu Department of Industry or the Port Vila Municipality, depending on the physical location. For the manufacture of armored personnel transport vehicles, submit an environmental impact assessment screening and any required defense or dual-use trade clearance to the competent authority. Secure occupational safety and fire clearance from the relevant national departments before commencing factory operations.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of the International Company
Business License Application (Form BLA-1)
Environmental impact assessment screening form or full EIA report
Building occupancy approval and fire safety certificate
Occupational safety and health clearance for factory premises
Import/export license or trade certificate for defense and tactical vehicle materials, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal or industry authority queries the business license, supplement the application with the missing technical drawings, environmental permits, or proof of compliance within 10 business days. Appeals against refusal lie to the Minister for Trade and Economic Development, with further recourse to the Supreme Court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives; coordination with the Vanuatu External Trade and Customs authorities for defense-related export controls
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License for Industrial Manufacturing (Class B – Vehicle and Special-Purpose Equipment Manufacture), supplemented by a Defense/Dual-Use Export Clearance where applicable

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Class 2 – Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) required for manufacturing plant with potential significant discharge of hazardous substances, noise, and industrial waste streams; smaller assembly-only operations may qualify for a Class 1 preliminary environmental review or registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Waste Management Act, Cap 300, and DEPC National Effluent Standards: wastewater pH 6.0–9.0, BOD ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L; solvent or VOC emissions minimized through best available techniques and enclosed workstations; all hazardous waste, oils, and batteries must be handled by licensed carriers under the Basel Convention controls implemented by DEPC

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services; structural load approval from the Public Works Department; workplace occupational health and safety clearance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour; and vehicle testing/road-worthiness configuration approval from the Vanuatu Transport and Infrastructure authorities for any prototype movement on public roads

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://customs.gov.vu (ASYCUDA World custom clearance); company registration oversight by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not levy corporate or personal income tax, so no general TIN is issued for direct-tax assessment. An International Company (IC) is constituted and registered under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; there is no statutory minimum capital. For CRS/FATCA identification, the IC may obtain an 8-digit continuous numeric Vanuatu TIN on request from VRC. If the IC physically imports or exports goods through Vanuatu, it must obtain a Customs Importer/Exporter Code by filing an application with VRC Customs supported by certified constitutional documents, registered agent consent, director passport copies, and a business licence where domestic activity is permitted. VAT registration is not applicable as no VAT/GST regime is currently in force.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, levies, and stamp duties on its shares and transfers under Section 3 of the International Companies Act. The entity operates under a strict offshore/non-domestic territorial scope and is statutorily prohibited from carrying on local beneficial business without a licence, preserving the tax-exempt zone character.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No income-tax check-the-box election exists because entity-level taxation is not imposed. Available statutory elections include: (i) continuation of the IC into or out of Vanuatu as a foreign-re-domiciled entity under the International Companies Act; (ii) conversion between an International Company and a domestic company under the Companies Act; (iii) application for a limited local licence electing approved domestic activities; (iv) hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable for Vanuatu direct-tax purposes as no tax on income is imposed.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST is in force; indirect taxation arises from customs import duty and excise under the Customs Act [Cap 77], stamp duty under the Stamp Duties Act [Cap 73], and the tourism/services levy where applicable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Any person importing or exporting physical goods must file electronic customs declarations through ASYCUDA World irrespective of turnover or value.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate is enforced by VRC. Customs clearance is electronic only via ASYCUDA World, covering declaration lodgement, risk assessment, duty accounting, and export processing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - since no VAT system operates, exports attract no output tax and no zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists. Exports of goods from Vanuatu are duty-neutral except for specified controlled commodities; imported materials subsequently re-exported may qualify for duty drawback under the Customs Act.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no VAT clawback because no VAT is levied. Audit scrutiny targets customs duty evasion, export mis-declaration, mis-description of controlled goods, and unauthorized domestic trading by an IC. Breaches of the Customs Act [Cap 77] expose the entity to forfeiture of goods, fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment; VFSC may strike off the IC or revoke its registration for carrying on unlicensed domestic business or AML/CFT non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — central monetary authority and exchange control administrator under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 112]
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is partially convertible. Current account transactions, including legitimate trade payments and service fees, are generally permitted through authorized dealers, subject to underlying documentary verification. Capital account movements and profit remittances require RBV approval or an authorized dealer's exchange control compliance clearance. An International Company is typically treated as a non-resident entity and may maintain foreign-currency external accounts, enabling profit repatriation outside the ordinary VUV clearing system, but any inbound VUV transfers for local operations remain subject to source-of-funds scrutiny and tax-neutrality confirmation. Remittance hurdles include proof of beneficial ownership, underlying contract validity, and the absence of any RBV restrictive designation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no mandatory statutory conversion ratio for export receipts; however, all export proceeds must be lodged with an authorized dealer in Vanuatu expeditiously after collection. Retention of foreign currency and use of external accounts is permissible where the exporter is an International Company, subject to RBV reporting requirements. Standard practice requires export documentation and evidence of shipment to support repatriation; failure to comply with the timing and documentation conditions may trigger exchange control penalties and future banking restrictions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Local Currency Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rated Medium-to-Low. Vanuatu's licensing framework does not recognize foreign electronic money institutions (EMIs) as authorized dealers for FX or clearing purposes. Offshore digital EMIs may be used for non-settlement ancillary payments, but they cannot satisfy RBV exchange control compliance, Government_Direct_Wire rails, or Diplomatic_LC settlement. A locally licensed EMI or a banking-as-a-service arrangement with a Tier-1 Vanuatu bank is required to achieve compliant cross-border clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for the final KYC interview of directors, the ultimate beneficial owner, and the authorized signatory. Remote account opening is permitted only on a conditional basis where the applicant is already a client of the same banking group or where an RBV-authorized introducer/registered agent conducts face-to-face verification under delegated due diligence rules. The Defense Tactical Hardware scope will almost certainly require at least one principal director to appear in person before the designated bank compliance officer in Port Vila.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure or politically exposed person (PEP) classification of beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current passport, notarized proof of address, source-of-wealth declaration, professional reference letters, corporate register extracts, and a clear provenance-of-funds file covering 24 months of bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 3040 defense hardware manufacturing classification triggering sanctions and export-control due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificate, end-use statement, international/national export license or registration, downstream risk assessment, anti-diversion undertaking, and the final military customer's sovereign procurement authorization.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company opaque structure with bearer-share or complex ownership concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certification, full beneficial ownership chain through natural persons, original certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, current register of members, and an organizational chart approved by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-volume pass-through of Government_Direct_Wire and Diplomatic_LC proceeds triggering unusual transaction thresholds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed supply agreement, pro-forma invoices, military procurement LCs, proof of delivery and acceptance, customs and importation records, and an internal treasury policy aligned with RBV anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism guidance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed through an authorized dealer in Vanuatu using SWIFT MT103 or MT202 wires, with the purpose code stating capital contribution or inward foreign direct investment. The originating bank must include the International Company's exact registered name, the Beneficial Owner's legal status, the corporate registration number, and a clear reference to the escrow or operational account. The authorized dealer will require the signed board resolution, subscription agreement, contribution schedule, and an exchange control declaration confirming that the funds are derived from lawful sources. Additional verification of the 24-month source-of-funds trail is mandatory for any transfer exceeding the bank's internal reporting threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments, MT202 for interbank cover payments, and Commercial Letters of Credit subject to UCP600 for defense and tactical-vehicle procurement. Diplomatic_LC transactions require a DC-advising bank in Vanuatu, with presentation of the original LC, shipping and insurance documents, freight forwarder bills, inspection certificates, and final acceptance certificates. Where the buyer is a sovereign ministry or embassy, the disbursement file must include the official diplomatic purchase order, end-user certificate, and government payment undertaking.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: RBV-approved spot VUV/USD and VUV/EUR foreign exchange contracts through authorized dealers
Vanuatu dollar forward contracts for settlement of recognized trade transactions with a maximum tenor of 12 months
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD/EUR where the underlying exposure is tied to verified export/import contracts
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV, provided settlement takes place outside Vanuatu and does not create unauthorized VUV liabilities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee and Renewal Declaration (Registered Agent's Certificate)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part thereof; if unpaid for 3 months after the anniversary, the Registrar may strike the International Company off the register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registered Agent (submitted via the registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation, concurrent with the annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the UBO confirmation may result in administrative fines under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act, and the registered agent may be required to cease acting for the company, leading to strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Register of Members and Register of Directors Audit Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registered Agent (inspection by the registrar if requested)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The registered agent must verify and update these registers at each annual renewal and upon any transfer or change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Contravention of International Companies Act record-keeping requirements may render the company and its directors liable to penalties of up to VUV 100,000; persistent default can lead to deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act; audit exemption applies irrespective of turnover, total assets, or number of shareholders.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting standard; if financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS or Vanuatu Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (Local GAAP) may be used.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and file an annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial owners; any transfer of shares or change in control must be updated in the Register of Members within 14 days and reflected in the next annual UBO confirmation. The UBO register is not publicly accessible but must be made available to the VFSC on request.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0%; Vanuatu International Companies are tax-exempt under the International Companies Act. No corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax apply to offshore income; the only annual charge is the VFSC license fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. The applicable compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Return / Annual Renewal Confirmation for an International Company, submitted electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC annual renewal and license fee are due by 31 December of each calendar year; there is no tax filing deadline because no CIT return is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Company name and IC registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Official name and VFSC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the exact registered name; no tax identification number is required for a non-resident owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed agent identity and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be appointed and maintained; non-resident owners are not required to have a physical office in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of current directors and company secretary, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an IC, directors may be non-resident natural persons or corporate directors; details are held by the registered agent.
Beneficial ownership information must be disclosed to the registered agent for VFSC compliance, though the IC register is not public.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC is not carrying on business in Vanuatu and remains eligible for tax exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident beneficial owner should ensure the declaration is accurate; no Schedule of income or assets is filed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the annual VFSC renewal fee triggers late penalties and a company strike-off risk. Continued default results in deregistration, loss of limited liability protection, and restoration costs.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network relevant to International Companies and imposes no dividend withholding tax. No tax residency certificate or treaty relief pre-approval is needed for outbound distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and treaty rate; Vanuatu does not levy withholding tax on interest, royalties, or technical fees paid by an International Company.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable; Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore imposes no Local File, Master File, or transfer pricing documentation obligation on International Companies.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No domestic Economic Substance Regulations apply to Vanuatu International Companies. However, a licensed defense exporter must demonstrate operational substance, including local risk management, procurement control, and compliance capacity, under VFSC licensing criteria.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Defense Export and Arms Brokerage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing, exporting, transshipping, or brokering all-terrain military tactical vehicles without the required VFSC special license and relevant military goods export authorization; failure to obtain end-user certificates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC license revocation, seizure of goods, suspension of banking payment rails, monetary penalties under Vanuatu trade control and licensing laws, and criminal prosecution for unlicensed arms dealing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined, imprisoned, disqualified from acting as directors, and subjected to travel bans while under investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying tactical military vehicles to UN, EU, or other internationally sanctioned states, regimes, or non-state actors; submitting false consignee declarations or forged end-user certificates through diplomatic letters of credit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Asset freezing, confiscation of financial proceeds, inclusion on consolidated sanctions lists, VFSC deregistration of the International Company, and criminal sanctions for violations of international sanctions directives implemented in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face personal asset forfeiture, targeted international travel bans, criminal prosecution, and possible imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting government direct wires or diplomatic letter-of-credit proceeds without performing customer due diligence, beneficial ownership verification, source-of-funds checks, or sanctions screening; structuring wire payments to circumvent AML reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework, suspension or loss of the VFSC license, freezing of bank accounts, and referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for criminal investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers may be subject to civil restitution obligations, personal disqualification, travel bans, and imprisonment for willful AML/CFT violations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and False VFSC Declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the International Company as a mere shell with no commercial substance, making materially false declarations in the VFSC annual return, or causing the IC to claim defense licensing privileges without genuine business substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Company strike-off, deregistration, VFSC fines, loss of the IC's limited liability status, forfeiture of exempt status, and prohibition against future re-registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced; directors and shareholders may be held personally liable for creditor claims and restitution, with travel bans imposed pending completion of investigations.
